summary: Columbus, Ohio, Fortune 200 company employee, software developer, experience in enterprise business market, strong interest in programming languages (Java, JavaScript, C, C++, Lisp, Scheme, Python), advocate for open source software, critical of corporate tech culture, believes in the importance of user experience, values simplicity in software design, supports functional programming paradigms, has a family, emphasizes the importance of education and continuous learning, skeptical of social media, critical of political and social issues, interested in technology's impact on society, has a long history with personal computing (from VIC-20 and Apple II to modern devices), enjoys discussing tech trends and their implications.
